about: Every factual sentence on the site, with what backs it. The page marks each one with data-claim="<id>"; web/src/claims.test.jsx fails on any unmarked sentence or missing evidence, and pipeline check C5 needs each named test to have passed in the newest recorded run of its suite. Spec: specs/phase-4-validation.md.

claims.claim: A small study of how CS departments treat generative AI; Claude Code wrote the code and Marcus supervised through specs, tests and reviews.
Each deliverable page is built from the project's recorded data.

claims.claim: Specs, progress logs and every recorded test run are in the GitHub repository.

claims.claim: Thinking tokens are already counted inside output; cache reads are the largest class because every message re-sends the conversation, which the cache serves cheaply.

sources.says: usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens reports how many of the billed output tokens were internal reasoning, so thinking is part of output.
Cache read tokens cost 0.1 times the base input price (0.05 times on Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5).

claims.claim: Usage rows repeat one response and resumed sessions copy old rows; responses are counted once, and summing rows would inflate cache reads by the ratio shown.

sources.says: /compact summarizes the conversation (custom instructions tell it what to preserve) and reads the whole conversation to do so, which is itself a large request; /clear starts a new session.
